currency.basis: Symbol ZIP is served live from the bank's official brand-manager downloads on 2026-10-04 and the same symbol design appears in the current swedbank.com header logotype; this is the design in current use.

identity.basis: Asset served by swedbank.com brand manager for Swedbank AB; symbol matches the header logotype of swedbank.com, the catalog entry's own domain swedbank.se group brand.

assessment.independenceRationale: All key observations come from one official primary source domain (swedbank.com): the brand download page, the symbol ZIP and the live header logotype; the header serves as an internal cross-check of variant, not as an independent second source. Identity is not disputed, so no additional independent source was required.

variant.basis: Symbol-only variant (no accompanying wordmark), square 48x48 canvas; the official standalone symbol variant offered for collaboration logotypes, matching the current gradient multi-tone brand palette.

candidate.detailsJudgement: All emblem details survive: gradient ring, inner disc gradient, oak foliage with leaf cutouts, trunk and roots, internal shading strokes; no lost strokes or negative-space features.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Proportions unchanged from the source (no scaling other than fit-to-cell); the circular emblem fills the square cell appropriately and stays recognizable at 24/32/48 px diagnostics on both themes; alpha outside the circle preserved.
candidate.rationale: Replaces the stored flat single-colour simplified oak with the official current gradient multi-tone emblem extracted losslessly from the bank's own brand-manager symbol ZIP; a supported fidelity correction to the current brand artwork.
candidate.role: Standalone brand symbol (oak tree emblem) without accompanying wordmark; suitable as an application icon.
transforms: No geometry transformation was needed: the source SVG is already a square 48x48 standalone emblem on a transparent canvas; it was used as-is (only namespace/style serialization preserved).

candidate.variant: Official current gradient multi-tone emblem variant from the bank's brand-manager symbol ZIP; square transparent canvas with the emblem's own circular field preserved as-is.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: The accepted icon is a flat single-colour (#ee7023) simplified rendition of the oak emblem; the candidate reproduces the official current gradient multi-tone artwork (brighter ring, lighter inner disc, detailed two-tone tree with leaf cutouts). This is a supported fidelity correction to the bank's current brand artwork, not a rebrand.

proposals.reason: Official current Swedbank symbol (gradient multi-tone orange sheep, viewBox 0 0 48 48) extracted losslessly from the bank's own brand-manager ZIP (The-Symbol_Collaboration-logotype/SVG/Symbol.svg). The stored icon.svg is a flat #ee7023 simplified sheep that does not match the official current gradient artwork; geometry and palette of the official asset are materially richer, so a replacement is justified as a supported update for the same bank.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Losslessly extracted official symbol-only original vector (SVG member of the official brand ZIP). Square 1:1 symbol without wordmark; gradient palette is the current brand artwork, so the stored flat simplified variant is an outdated rendition of the same mark, justifying a replacement.

sources.observation: Official brand/logotype download page offering Swedbank_Logotype.zip and The-Symbol_Collaboration-logotype.zip (symbol-only, AI/PDF/PNG/SVG).
Downloaded ZIP; member The-Symbol_Collaboration-logotype/SVG/Symbol.svg selected via source-material. viewBox 0 0 48 48, square, symbol-only (no wordmark), gradient multi-tone orange sheep in circle.
Current site header logotype (symbol + wordmark, viewBox 0 0 598 130) corroborates the same symbol design as the standalone Symbol.svg.
